item.title: COUNTY COMMISSION PREVIEW
item.description: The Franklin County Commission will hold their regular weekly meeting this morning. A very short and routine agenda is expected, with only one item listed. item.title: CEDAR COVE DIRECTOR DIES
item.description: Steve Klein, Executive Director of the Cedar Cove Feline Conservatory and Education Center, died unexpectedly Sunday, February 22nd, at the age of 55. He was found unresponsive at his residence Sunday morning. Emergency responders responded immediately and made every effort to revive him, but their efforts were unsuccessful. item.title: TRUMP TO GIVE STATE OF THE UNION
item.description: President Donald Trump will give the State of the Union address tonight in front of a joint session of Congress and invited guests. The address is mandated by the constitution. George Washington delivered the first message in 1790. Thomas Jefferson switched to a written format in 1801, which continued for over a century until Woodrow Wilson broke the tradition in 1913 to promote his agenda in person. item.description: Downtown Ottawa has become a hub of renovation over the past year, with new businesses going in and more people shopping there. Main Street Director Sarah Stauffer says a lot of grant money is being funneled into the downtown area. item.title: WEST FRANKLIN NEW SHOES
item.description: AdventHealth Ottawa had another successful year with the Shoes That Fit Program. They gave away over 1,100 pairs of shoes to elementary students in Franklin County. West Franklin Superintendent Matt Brenzikofer: When budgets are tight, many families can’t afford new shoes. But, new shoes can transform their world in ways you cant even imagine. AdventHealth Ottawa believes new shoes can bring a child dignity, joy, and confidence, allowing them to step into their lives with pride.

item.description: Turnaround in the Kansas Legislature marks the deadline by which most bills must be passed out of their chamber of origin in order to remain alive for the rest of the session. item.title: BALDWIN WALKS AND CROSSINGS
item.description: If you are headed to Baldwin City today, be aware of some construction going on. Two crosswalk projects are currently under construction inside Baldwin City limits, both affecting Highway 56. New sidewalks, as well as a new crosswalk, are being installed at the Santa Fe Drive and Hwy 56 intersection in order to connect Heritage Subdivision walkers and bikers to the rest of town. item.title: Commander Jerry B. Reinhardt, USN (Ret.)
item.description: Jerry Bruce Reinhardt passed away on February 21, 2026. He died peacefully in his Stilwell, Kansas home, surrounded by his loving family. He was 93 years old. Jerry was born to Elsie and Ted Reinhardt on August 22, 1932 in Salina, Kansas. His sister, Joyce Beverly, was born a few years later on November 10, 1935. Jerry attended Kansas Wesleyan University.
